quoted_text: GBTDS observing will be concentrated in six 72-day seasons, three early in the mission and three late in the mission. During these seasons, each of the six fields is observed every 12.1 minutes, in the wide W (F146) filter, with an exposure time of 67 seconds, and every 12 hours or faster in the Z (F087) and K (F213) filters, with final filter and cadence choices to be determined through community input.
